title: Tritsch-Tratsch Polka
identity: Johann Strauss II, Tritsch-Tratsch Polka, Op. 214 (1858). Stradivarius Editions offers an E-flat saxophone and piano arrangement by Frédéric Cellier, c. 2:25, with a 13-page score and five-page part.
